lesson.information: some quick and easy activities to motivate reluctant writers.

lesson.information: meet an amazing newt that vibrates to learn about adjectives nouns and verbs.

lesson.information: quickly create poems and descriptive paragraphs following the nessy plan.

lesson.name: story plans
lesson.information: create character portraits and follow a simple structure to connect story ideas.

lesson.name: linking paragraphs
lesson.information: learn how to construct a simple paragraph using colour and bullet points.

lesson.name: past tense
lesson.information: practise activities to know which forms of the verb are used in the past tense.

lesson.name: thinking skills
lesson.information: sequencing, memory strategies and listening skills are all important areas for dyslexics to develop.

lesson.name: punctuation
lesson.information: exercises and strategies to help develop an awareness of punctuation.

lesson.name: reading accuracy
lesson.information: visual tracking exercises help prevent the eye from skipping letters and words as they are read.

lesson.name: dictionary skills
lesson.information: a strategy for using the dictionary that will be helpful for those who have difficulty recalling the sequence of the alphabet.
